rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_knowledge tenant table, then drops the taxonomy_assignment, publication, block, revision, draft and knowledge_object tables and the northstar_knowledge schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. Published revisions are immutable, so no data is ever mutated in place by this migration.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_knowledge schema with knowledge_object, draft, revision, block, publication and taxonomy_assignment tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped knowledge table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 3 knowledge documents and publication baseline
